title: Check an unexpected balance or transaction

summary.text: Daedalus shows each transaction's amount, the fee of a transaction you sent and any deposit, and says when a wallet's transaction history is still being synced. Transaction metadata is not moderated and may contain inappropriate content, so Daedalus hides it until you select Show unmoderated content.

problem.text: ADA missing balance zero funds pending transaction not received rejected transaction fee

symptoms.text: ADA missing balance zero funds pending transaction not received rejected transaction fee

user_phrases.text: ADA missing balance zero funds pending transaction not received rejected transaction fee

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.2 tag source and its English interface text. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Check that the wallet selected in the sidebar is the wallet you expect the funds in.
resolutions.why: Each wallet has its own balance and transactions.

resolutions.action: If the wallet's Summary says its transaction history is still being synced with the blockchain, wait until syncing finishes.
resolutions.why: A wallet that is still syncing does not yet show all of its transactions.

resolutions.action: Open Transactions and select the transaction to see its amount and Transaction ID, its Transaction fee if you sent it, and its Deposit if it has one.
resolutions.why: The details separate the amount from the fee and deposit.

expected_outcome.text: You can see each transaction's amount, fee and any deposit in the wallet that holds it.

do_not: Do not treat transaction metadata as checked: Daedalus does not moderate it, and it may contain inappropriate content.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Retrievable only; no FAQ item is published for this entry.
